name: Declan O'Connell
bio:
Declan's motorsport journey began tinkering with engines in his father's Dublin garage. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering before joining a small Formula Ford team, quickly rising through the ranks with his meticulous approach to problem-solving. He spent years honing his skills in various European racing series before making the jump to NASCAR, drawn by the challenge and the competitive spirit. 

As a technical director, Declan believes in data-driven decisions and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. He pushes his team to explore innovative solutions while maintaining a laser focus on reliability and performance. What sets him apart is his ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies that resonate with the entire team, from the engineers in the garage to the driver on the track.

physical.facialHair: Short, trimmed salt and pepper beard
physical.description: A man with a stern but kind face, bearing the marks of years spent in high-pressure environments.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly brewed cup of Irish breakfast tea at precisely 10:00 AM every morning.
